predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Estac Troyes vs Lens: Expected Goals, Transitional Fragility & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Lens' overwhelming expected goal generation of 2.82 xG per match and Troyes' depleted transition defense point decisively toward an away victory.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Lens Away Win via second-half pressure overload (Confidence: High, Value: High)
Secondary Thesis: Over 2.5 Total Goals fueled by Troyes' defensive vulnerabilities (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Contingency Thesis: Low-block stalemate resulting in a narrow draw (Confidence: Low, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Lens seek first away league win against struggling, leaky Troyes

spf.comment: Lens hold a staggering +11.7 xG differential against Troyes' four-match multi-goal losing skid, making an away victory the most statistically robust trajectory.

over_under.comment: A combined expected goal baseline of 3.44 and Troyes conceding 2.20 goals per match firmly favor Over 2.5.

score.comment: A 1:2 Lens victory captures away dominance with a home consolation, while 0:2 reflects a controlled clean sheet.

goals.comment: Poisson densities peak at 3 goals (21.8%) and 2 goals (19.0%), aligning with multi-goal Lens outcomes.

bqc.comment: Troyes' pattern of first-half resistance followed by second-half defensive collapse underpins Draw-Loss as the leading script.
